name: Sakthi Finance Limited
about: Sakthi Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides asset financing services in India. It is involved in the pre-owned financing of commercial vehicles, infrastructure equipment, machineries, interest rates and charges, consumer education literature, etc. The company offers non-convertible debentures, fixed and cumulative income deposits, and subordinated bonds. It operates through a network of branches located in Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, and Puducherry. Sakthi Finance Limited was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Coimbatore, India.
